name: Einsturzpunkt
avoid: Никакой выдумки, поданной как факт. Не смаковать жестокость ради шока. Не выдавать версии за доказанное. ИИ-кадр НИКОГДА не изображает само реальное происшествие и его жертв — только конструкции, машины, материалы, погоду, пустые помещения; механизм отказа показывается СХЕМОЙ, а не поддельной «хроникой». Не использовать число погибших как крючок в заголовке. Стихия сама по себе — не тема канала: ураган, землетрясение и наводнение входят только как нагрузка, которую рукотворная система должна была выдержать и не выдержала. Никаких шаблонов заголовка: каждый пишется заново под свой случай. Заголовок, который получается подстановкой одного слова в предыдущий, не годится.
script_extra:
German-language documentary reconstruction of ONE engineered system that failed. Standard High German. The system can be anything people built and ran: a bridge, a reactor, an airliner, a chemical plant, a rocket, a ferry, a theme-park ride, a national power grid, or a megaproject that never worked as promised.

Work from what an official inquiry established. Name the object, the year, the operator, the engineers, the report. If a fact is disputed, say it is disputed.

Open on the ordinary day, named and specific. Build the chain of small decisions that made the outcome inevitable — each reasonable on its own at the time. Then the failure itself, minute by minute, in plain language a non-engineer follows. Then the aftermath: what the inquiry found, what changed in the rules, and what did not.

The MECHANISM is the spine of this channel, not the body count. Spend real time on why the material, the structure or the system gave way — the load path, the corrosion, the pressure, the missing bolt, the alarm that was acknowledged and ignored, the interlock that was bypassed. This is what the diagram inserts illustrate and what distinguishes the channel.

WHEN THE SUBJECT IS A MEGAPROJECT THAT FAILED WITHOUT A CATASTROPHE — an airport years late, a tunnel far over budget, a bridge nobody uses — the same spine applies, but the failure to trace is the DECISION chain: the estimate that was never checked, the design changed after construction began, the authority that approved itself. Give the money in real figures and say who paid. There are no victims to protect here, so the restraint goes instead into never sneering at the people involved.

NEVER speculate about what victims experienced. Never invent dialogue. Never linger on suffering for effect. The restraint is the tone.

STYLE: sober, precise, unhurried German. No greetings, no direct address to the viewer.

VISUAL CUES: directing notes in SQUARE BRACKETS — the object, the era, where diagrams and archive belong. Stripped before the voice-over.
topic_formula:
German-language reconstructions of ENGINEERED SYSTEMS THAT FAILED — and of the mechanism that made the failure inevitable. The channel is NOT limited to structures that collapse: a roof giving way, a reactor running away and a ferry rolling over are the SAME story told about different hardware. That story is the load path, the corrosion, the pressure, the missing bolt, the alarm nobody answered.

TOPICS ARE GENERATED, NOT PICKED FROM A LIST. Build every topic as a COMBINATION of three axes below. The axes multiply out to far more episodes than this channel can ever produce — that is the point: the niche does not run out, and it must never be treated as a catalogue to work through.

AXIS 1 — DOMAIN. Seven families; every one of them holds thousands of real objects worldwide. Rotate across them — never three videos in a row from the same family.

  1. BAUWERKE — bridges, dams, towers, roofs, grandstands, tunnels, halls, silos, car parks, quay walls, offshore platforms.
  2. VERKEHR — aircraft and helicopters, railways and signalling, ships and ferries, cable cars, lifts and escalators, dock and harbour accidents.
  3. ENERGIE UND KERNTECHNIK — reactors, turbine halls, transformer stations, nationwide blackouts, hydro plants, wind turbines, battery and grid fires.
  4. INDUSTRIE UND CHEMIE — refineries, chemical works, gas storage, fertiliser depots, mines, grain elevators, steelworks, pipelines, tailings dams.
  5. RAUMFAHRT UND HOCHTECHNIK — rockets and launch pads, satellites, radio telescopes, submarines and deep-sea craft, large research facilities.
  6. ALLTAGSTECHNIK — theme-park rides, stadium crowds and barriers, large aquariums, cranes, scaffolding, building services, fire protection and evacuation systems.
  7. MEGAPROJEKTE OHNE KATASTROPHE — the airport that opened fifteen years late, the bridge nobody drives on, the tunnel that swallowed two billion. Nobody died; it is still a failure of engineering and of the decisions around it. This is the ground the LIVE German competitor actually runs on.

AXIS 2 — MECHANISM. This is the spine of the episode, and it is what makes the same object worth a second, different film: a crane fails one way from metal fatigue and another way from a bypassed interlock.
  Materialermüdung, Korrosion, Wasserstoffversprödung, Resonanz und Flattern, Knicken und Stabilitätsverlust, progressiver Kollaps, Wasserschlag, Staubexplosion, BLEVE, durchgehende Reaktion, thermisches Durchgehen, Überdruck, Setzung und Kolkbildung des Fundaments, Schweißnaht- und Schraubenversagen, Softwarefehler in der Steuerung, überbrückte Verriegelung, ignorierter Alarm, aufgeschobene Wartung, falsch angesetzte Bemessungslast, fehlende Redundanz, Einzelfehlerstelle, Fehler im Betriebshandbuch.

AXIS 3 — WHERE IT IS DOCUMENTED. Each of these bodies has published hundreds of investigation reports; one report is one episode, and new ones appear every month.
  BFU, BEA and NTSB (aviation) — BEU, EBA and RAIB (rail) — BSU and MAIB (marine) — CSB (chemical industry) — IAEA and INES reports (nuclear) — DGUV, BAuA and Berufsgenossenschaften (industrial accidents) — national building-inquiry commissions, court files, expert opinions, insurer post-mortems.

HOW TO COMBINE: one domain + one mechanism + one documented case. If a pairing has already been used on this channel, change the MECHANISM rather than merely swapping the object — that is where the supply of episodes actually is.

PICK THE DOMAIN FIRST, then the title. Never the other way round: choosing the words first is how this channel ended up with fifty variations of one sentence.

TITLES ARE WRITTEN FRESH, ONE AT A TIME. This channel has NO title template — and no rotation of templates either, because a rotation is only four templates instead of one. If a viewer scrolling the feed can see the pattern, the pattern has already stopped working.

What follows is not a set of forms to fill in. It is four MEASURED FINDINGS about why particular titles were clicked, with the numbers attached, on real channels. Understand what is doing the work in each one, then write the sentence this particular failure deserves, in your own words. A finding you cannot honestly apply to the case in front of you is one you leave alone.

TEST BEFORE YOU ANSWER: could your title be produced by swapping one noun in a title this channel has already used? Then it is wallpaper — write a different one. Never open two consecutive titles with the same words. The channel already carries 46 titles built on 'Warum ... brandneu'; that ground is used up, and newness is worth mentioning only when the object really was new and that is the shock.

FINDING 1 — newness that failed anyway is the strongest single hook measured here (x16.41 on the dormant channel):
  x16.41  1 094 223  'Warum explodierte dieser brandneue Wasserpark?'
           138 677  'Warum ist dieser brandneue Wolkenkratzer eingestürzt?'
  (the SAME two titles are the top two on the operator's French channel)
  Four things were present together in those two titles. This is what was doing the work — not a checklist to tick off, and not a sentence to reproduce:
   1. A QUESTION, usually 'Warum'. Not a statement of what happened.
   2. The demonstrative 'dieser/diese' — THIS one, a specific object.
   3. The paradox of newness where it applies: 'brandneu', 'nagelneu', 'gerade eröffnet', 'nach nur drei Jahren'.
   4. A LARGE MAN-MADE OBJECT the viewer can instantly picture.
  The verb follows the hardware, not the habit: einstürzte, explodierte, sank, kenterte, ausfiel, durchbrannte, abstürzte, außer Kontrolle geriet, sich selbst zerriss.

FINDING 2 — scale, money and consequence pull without any question word at all (the live competitor's whole feed runs on this):
  'Gotthard Tunnel: 2 Milliarden für Nichts?'
  'Diese deutsche Baustelle blockiert ganz Europa'
  'Das passiert gerade im Brennerbasistunnel'
  Use it for domain 7 and for anything where the object is famous but the failure is slow: cost, delay, uselessness, a system everyone depends on. Object plus a number, or object plus a consequence.

FINDING 3 — the closing minutes of a NAMED vehicle or run. Measured: this shape carries the single biggest number in the niche, 2 378 328 on a live 298 000-subscriber channel, on a German high-speed train identified by its service number.
  Shape, NOT a text to copy: a phrase about the final minutes + the train number, flight number, ship name or plant designation. This is the ONE case where a proper name belongs at the front — and only for a vehicle or run a German viewer can place. Vary the wording every time: letzte Minuten, letzte Stunde, die Nacht, der letzte Start, der letzte Halt.

FINDING 4 — what became of a famous project. Measured: 1 073 342 on a live 133 000-subscriber channel, on a megacity project that was announced everywhere and quietly shrank.
  Shape, NOT a text to copy: a question about what actually became of X, where X is something the audience heard promised and never heard of again.

HARD RULE: NEVER reuse a competitor's title word for word, and never take one of the measured examples above as the topic itself. Those numbers describe the SHAPE that works. Copying the sentence is taking someone else's work, and the same video already exists on their channel — the viewer has seen it.

HARD RULE: look at the ALREADY COVERED list before you write. Whatever shape it leans on right now — even a winning one, even one from the findings above — is the shape you do not use again this time. The failure this guards against is not the wrong shape; it is the same shape five times running.

WHAT LOSES, measured on the same channels:
  x0.15  10 097  superlative with no object
  x0.31  20 509  a period, not an object
  median 105     named obscure foreign-local incidents

HARD RULE: never build a title on the NAME of an incident the German audience does not already recognise. Build it on the OBJECT and the paradox. National relevance is NOT the winning variable — the Love Parade disaster, famous in Germany, scored only x0.36.

HARD RULE: the subject must be a system PEOPLE BUILT AND RAN. Weather, earthquake, flood and storm enter only as the load the structure was supposed to carry and did not — never as the topic itself. A hurricane is not an episode; a stadium roof designed for a wind speed it never met is.

HARD RULE ON TONE: real people died. Never speculate about what victims felt, never invent dialogue, never use a death toll as a hook.

Палитра harsh подогнана под этот замер: было 3.15 с медианы (на 58% медленнее конкурента), стало 2.10 с и 18.1 склейки в минуту.

НИША РАСШИРЕНА 02.09.2026. Было: только обрушения конструкций — и 52 темы подряд вышли близнецами «Warum stürzte dieser brandneue …». Стало семь доменов: строения; транспорт (авиация, ЖД, суда, канатки, лифты); энергетика и атом; промышленность и химия; космос и высокая техника; бытовая техника и массовые сооружения (аттракционы, трибуны, аквариумы, краны); мегапроекты-провалы без жертв. Стержень прежний — механизм отказа, а не число погибших; название Einsturzpunkt читается теперь как точка, в которой система перестаёт держать, а не только как обрушение стены. Добавлено ВТОРОЕ семейство заголовков (объект + деньги или последствие) — оно взято с живого конкурента, а не выдумано, и требует чередования с прежним «Warum … brandneu». Стихия закреплена как нагрузка, а не как тема.

ЗАМЕР НИШИ 02.09.2026 (поиск по видео, не по каналам; крупные телеканалы отброшены). Живых немецких каналов в нише пять: tatsache 298 000 подписчиков, медиана 610 617, отклик x2.05, длина 22.0 мин, топ 2 378 328 («Die katastrophalen letzten Minuten im ICE 884»); Megabauten 133 000, медиана 82 593, x0.62, 14.9 мин, топ 1 073 342 («Was wirklich mit The Line passiert ist»); Gigantische Bauwerke 8 260, медиана 61 311, x7.42, 8.4 мин; Dark Records Deutsch 10 000, медиана 68 843, x6.88, 14.9 мин, молчит 180 дней; Blackbox Deutschland 3 380, медиана 4 128, x1.22, 22.4 мин. Из двух верхних вынуты семейства заголовков C («letzte Minuten» + имя рейса или судна) и D («Was wirklich mit X passiert ist»).
ДЛИНА пересчитана на этом замере: медиана по всем пяти 14.9 мин, взвешенная по просмотрам 19.7, среди отклика x1+ 18.45, среди каналов нашего размера (до 15 000 подписчиков) 14.9. Взята последняя как единственная сопоставимая с нашим положением — minutes 14 -> 15.

name: El Precio de una Idea
avoid: Никаких приветствий. Не утверждать, что чувствует конкретный человек зрителя — только закономерности. Без лозунгов и самопомощи «выбери себя» — в этой нише такое проваливается в 100 раз.
script_extra:
Spanish-language documentary about a philosopher or a single work.

SHAPE: follow one mind through time. What happened to this person, and what it made them think. Alternate between the life and the idea it produced, so neither runs dry. There is no withheld mystery here — the pull is watching a worldview being forged and what it cost the person who forged it.

NEVER address the viewer's own life. No 'you', no advice, no lessons to apply. This is measured, not taste: on the reference channel the same author scored 199,346 views when the subject was his ordeal and 538 when the subject was the viewer's demons.

Name dates, places, correspondents, book titles and the year of publication out loud — they are the spine of a documentary.

STYLE: calm, unhurried, Castilian Spanish. The tone of someone recounting a life they have studied for years, not selling insight. End where the idea outlives the person.

VISUAL CUES: directing notes in SQUARE BRACKETS — period, location, where archive material belongs. They are stripped before the voice-over.
topic_formula:
Spanish-language long-form documentaries about philosophers, their lives and the ideas those lives produced.

MEASURED on the reference channel (54 videos, median 19,738 views, spread 17x between best and worst):
  WON  330k-166k : why intelligence leads to loneliness (Schopenhauer); the philosopher who reinvented God (Spinoza); the genius who descended into the darkness of the human soul (Dostoyevsky); the book that drove Jung to the edge of the abyss; the warning the world refused to hear (Orwell)
  LOST 1.7k-538  : existentialist philosophy explained; HOW TO BECOME the man Nietzsche admired; HOW TO BUILD a just society (Rousseau); the book that reveals YOUR inner demons (Jung)

The distinguishing variable is exact, and it is NOT the thinker's name: Jung appears in both halves — 199,346 views for 'the book that drove HIM to the abyss' and 538 for 'the book that reveals YOUR demons'. Same author, same length, same format.

A video WINS when the promise is about what happened TO THE THINKER or TO THE WORLD — third person, past tense, a catastrophe or a cost.
A video FAILS when the promise is about what the VIEWER should do or get — 'how to become', 'how to build', 'your demons'. Never write a title in the second person.

Already covered on the reference channel, do NOT repeat: Schopenhauer, Spinoza, Dostoyevsky, Nietzsche, Jung's Red Book, Orwell's 1984, Musashi.

Length is table stakes, not an advantage: the failures run 52-86 minutes too. Do NOT pad to reach length: a tight video beats a padded one. Win on the promise, not the runtime.

topic_formula:
German-language LOST BUILDING KNOWLEDGE: cheap everyday objects rebuilt into
home cooling, heating and power, framed as knowledge the industry suppressed.

MEASURED 2026-08-29 on @VerlorenesBauwissen, not assumed:
  channel age 6 weeks (opened 2026-07-14), 24 videos, ONE VIDEO PER DAY
  13 300 subs, 1 334 000 total views, engagement 1.35
  median 25 576 views, best 763 108, worst 1 657 — spread of 460x
  LENGTH 13:15-16:18, median 14:55. They aim at exactly 15 minutes.

THE TITLE FORMULA THAT WINS — 23 of 24 titles follow it literally:

  Dieser/Dieses/Diese
  + <PRICE>€            a round, small, believable price: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25,
                        35, 40, 45, 50, 60, 70, 80, 300
  + <MUNDANE OBJECT>    Betonrohr, Gartenschlauch, Zinkwanne, Kupferspirale,
                        Abflussrohr, Brunnenring, Ölradiator vom Sperrmüll,
                        Schrottplatz-Autokühler, alte TV-Antenne, PVC-Rohr
  + <BENEFIT TO *YOUR* HOME>
                        Kühlt Dein Haus / Speichert Solarstrom /
                        Erzeugt GRATIS Strom / Wird Zur Klimaanlage
  + <ABSOLUTE>          FÜR IMMER · GRATIS · KOSTENLOS · OHNE Strom ·
                        OHNE Batterie · KEINE Klimaanlage · Auf 13°C
  + <SUPPRESSION HOOK>  Warum Ist Es VERBOTEN? · Warum VERBERGEN Sie Es? ·
                        Warum Baut Ihn NIEMAND? · Warum Weiß Das Niemand?

WHAT SEPARATES 763 000 FROM 1 657 — measured, not guessed:
  WINS  price present, round and small (50€); object utterly ordinary
        (concrete pipe); absolute benefit (FÜR IMMER); hardest suppression
        word (VERBOTEN).
  LOSES no price at all; exotic or historical object ("Windturm" house,
        3 000 years old); a conspiracy aimed at an industry rather than a
        thing the viewer could build this weekend.
  The single English-language title scored 3 735 — bottom third. Stay German.

SO, FOR EACH VIDEO:
  Pick ONE object a viewer already owns or can buy for under 100€, and ONE
  physical effect it can plausibly produce in a house. The video must answer
  "could I build this on Saturday?" — not "wasn't that interesting".
  Never open with history. Open with the object and its price.

CAUTION — READ BEFORE COPYING THIS NICHE:
  Several of these claims are physically doubtful (a 50€ pipe cooling a
  house FOREVER; a TV aerial producing free electricity). The formula
  earns its views from the suppression hook, and YouTube demonetises
  health-and-science misinformation. Copy the STRUCTURE — price, ordinary
  object, buildable this weekend, withheld knowledge — but keep every
  physical claim true. Geothermal cooling through buried pipe is real;
  free energy from an aerial is not.

script_extra:
German-language science documentary about ONE famous animal — living or extinct. Standard High German, warm narrator, no exclamation marks.

STRUCTURE, measured from the reference channel:
- The first shot runs long. Do not cut for at least 15 seconds. Open on the animal itself in near-darkness, described so the artist can draw it.
- Open on the CLAIM everyone believes, then say plainly that it is wrong.
- Then earn it: what was found, where, by whom, in what year.
- Mid-video, give ONE number the viewer can picture (length against a human, bite force against a car crusher). Name the study it comes from.
- Close on what is still unknown. Never on a call to subscribe.

VOICE: explain, do not sell. No 'unglaublich', no 'du wirst schockiert sein'. The facts are strange enough.

HONESTY: every reconstruction is a reconstruction. If palaeontologists disagree, say both sides. If the evidence is one fossil, say it is one fossil.
